title: Implement --json flag — structured JSON output
description: When --json flag is set, skip the TUI entirely. Compute all stats and output a structured JSON object to stdout. Exit 0.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON matches the documented schema (overall, currentTask, byCategory, loopSessions, totalRuntimeSeconds)
No Ink rendering occurs when --json is set

steps.description: Add JSON output path to statusCommand
steps.details: In statusCommand: if (options.json) { const tasks = await readTasks(agentDir); const stats = calculateProgress(tasks); const history = await readHistoryStats(agentDir); const activity = await readRecentActivity(agentDir); const currentTask = activity[activity.length-1]?.taskId ? ... : null; console.log(JSON.stringify({ overall: stats.overall, currentTask, byCategory: stats.byCategory, loopSessions: history.sessionCount, totalRuntimeSeconds: history.totalRuntimeSeconds }, null, 2)); return }
Run `npm run dev -- status --json | jq .overall.percent`. Should return a number. Run `npm run dev -- status --json | jq .` and verify the full structure.
